every single Umamusume and carve my 
victory into history.

The one who reigns supreme over the world 
of racing is none other than I, Orfevre.

text_block_list.text:
"That is the ultimate truth of this 
world... If so, I have only to prove it."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Work hard. So that I may take the 
throne."

text_block_list.text:

Orfevre.
